decisionsTitle: The owner's to-do list catches up with the live system, and the restore gets a runbook
decisionsSection:
**Why.** On 2026-11-01 `docs/OWNER-TODO.md` still listed the race as unpublished (it was published by 2026-10-02 and full that day, §632), `docs/PLATFORM.md` said Vercel returns to Hobby after the race although its own rule (two consecutive months under 3 Active CPU-hours; October paced 6.9 against Hobby's 4, and going over pauses the site for about 30 days) says otherwise, and the backups box in `SETUP.md` §25 and §30 pointed at nothing.

**Decision.** Documentation only. Item 12 is done and names what remains for race day: «Startul cursei» (event editor, «Când și unde») and «Categorii de vârstă» («Clasament») before any result. Item 16 says that approving the new privacy notice and terms is what opens the results, that the notice in force is wrong on the IP address kept with every e-signature (§771) and on contact messages (§778), the order (lawyer, then `/admin/legal` on production: notice, terms, declarations, before 21 November), and two data questions for the lawyer: how long group-run declarations are kept, and whether the notice must name «Lista internă de așteptare» (§854). Item 19 names the missing GitHub secret `PRODUCTION_JOB_SECRET`. New items: the restore rehearsal, second-person recovery access (BR-BUS-101), Mailgun's two dates, the Vercel December rule. `docs/RUNBOOKS.md` gains «Restoring production from Neon's history»: a restore to a new branch only, a read-only count, bringing rows back, deleting the branch. Rows are brought back only under conditions (a free counted place, no erased row, dependent rows with it, a psql pipe with no file). Its console labels are still from memory because neon.com was unreachable from the build and review sessions; the section says so and what to re-read. `SETUP.md` §25 and §30 stay unticked and point to it.

**Refused.** Ticking the backup boxes (nobody has rehearsed a restore), and any restore over production.
changelogLine: - **Owner's to-do list brought up to date, and a runbook for restoring production from Neon's history** — race published, results gated on the new notice and terms, the missing `PRODUCTION_JOB_SECRET`, Vercel's December rule. §NNN.
